requirements.statement: The sign-in page offers a "Forgot password?" link that starts a password-reset request when selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer is on the sign-in page, when the customer selects "Forgot password?", then a password-reset request can be started.

requirements.statement: A customer can complete a password reset using a valid reset link, replacing that account's password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer has a valid, unused, unexpired reset link for an account, when the customer completes a password reset with a replacement password, then that account's password is replaced.

requirements.statement: The response to a password-reset request is identical whether the account exists or does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given two otherwise equivalent password-reset requests, one for an existing account and one for a nonexistent account, when each request is submitted, then the customer-visible request responses are identical and do not reveal account existence.

requirements.statement: Password-reset requests are limited to five per account per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given five password-reset requests for an account have been accepted within an hour, when an additional request for that account is made within that hour, then it is limited so that no more than five requests for that account are accepted in that hour.
Given a reset link has been used to complete a password reset, when anyone attempts to use that same link again, then it cannot complete another password reset.

requirements.statement: Each reset link expires 30 minutes after it is issued.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset link was issued at a known time, when someone attempts to use it at or after 30 minutes from issuance, then it cannot complete a password reset.

requirements.statement: Completing a password reset signs the account out of every active session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account has one or more active sessions, when its password reset is completed, then every previously active session for that account is signed out.

requirements.statement: The account owner is notified after every successful password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account's password reset completes successfully, when the reset succeeds, then the account owner is notified of that reset; each further successful reset causes its own notification.
